_comment: Stub MCP-server fixture used by `chio mcp wrap --e2e-fixture` in run-with-kb-mcp.sh --check. Mirrors the small KB-MCP read-only surface (kb.search/kb.fetch/kb.list/kb.describe). The destructive `delete_record` row is included so the replay exercises a denied frame and produces a deny mediation transcript.

tools.name: echo
tools.description: KB MCP echo (read-only). Used to confirm the bridge is up before issuing a real query.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a KB-side article by path.

tools.name: delete_record
tools.description: Destructive record removal. MUST be denied by the wrapper under the demo policy.
